name: Meisa no Sekai
source:
--A sofa and a bed.
Next to a flat-screen TV is a decorative plant.
This room's too tidy; it doesn't feel lived in at all.

This 12 square meter apartment is everything to me. I can't get out of it.
There's a guy here; he seems like he's from another world. He's staring at me with a faint smile. 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5170]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——一张沙发和一张床。
平面电视旁边有一株装饰性植物。
这房间太整洁了；根本感觉不到有人居住。

这套12平方米的公寓对我来说就是一切。我无法摆脱它。
这里有一个人；他似乎来自另一个世界。他带着淡淡的微笑盯着我。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5170]NovelGame[/url]]
